modelVersions.name: Tenebriflora-Illustrious
modelVersions.description:
This model was originally created for private use, I was planning to train other LoRAs based on it, but it turned out to be quite interesting itself, so I uploaded it.

Trained on the images generated by myself. All pictures were with black background, monochrome and greyscale. since I use this model ONLY for sketch style, I will describe how to work with it:

  • The tags ‘greyscale, monochrome, simple background, black background’ will allow you to get what you see in my examples. You can replace the background with any other color, it worked for me without any problems.

  • To make the style more ‘sketchy’ I suggest using the following tags ‘sketch, unfinished, messy lineart’ it gives sketchy and little bit more cleaner look.

  • Eyes. I'll divide the tags into three levels.

  1. First: Add nothing, get slightly thick lashes and small bags under the eyes.

  2. Second: Add ‘black eyes, bags under eyes’ Now this is similar to what you see in my examples.

  3. Third: To stylize the eyes even more, I recommend adding ‘thick eyelashes, (black eyeshadow:0.8), big eyes’.

  • The weight on any of the above tags can be changed to your liking.

  • Artists tags work well with styling as well. So try it out and experiment.

  • For ‘colored style’ I can't say anything yet, as I haven't tried and experimented with it. If any information comes up, I will add it here.

Additional information:

  • MODEL IS EXPERIMENTAL so don't expect much.

  • Trained on the WAI-NSFW-illustrious-SDXL v9

  • Weight is around 0.65-0.8. I use 0.7.

  • You can try to generate on bigger resolution, so lines can be thinner and cleaner. My current workflow is 1024x1460 x1.25 upscaling. But I still experimenting with that.
trainedWords: monochrome, greyscale, simple background, black background

modelVersions.description:
For me, it's not a complete style. However, you can use it as such. I have trained it for use with artist tags/other styles.

Therefore, don't expect too much. I trained it as a support-LoRA for my ‘cute’ styles, yep.

Model Information:

  • In short, this model allows for slightly more rounded facial/eye features, thickened eyelashes, mixed linework, some flat colors.

  • You can enhance each effect with the tag ‘flat color’, ‘no lineart’ etc.

  • I recommend it to be used with artists tags.

  • The weight is adjustable as you wish. I work from 0.35 to 0.85. On average 0.65-0.8. In general, try it yourself.

items.name: [Styles] Muses in Dark | Semi-real Style - Illustrious/PonyXL - Illustrious|NAI
items.description:
Styles LoRA based on IllustriousXL and NoobAi, inspired by the way I visualized characters from chatbots, visual novels, and choice-based games. This LORA tend to handle semi-real artstyle.

Using FallenIncursio's PaSanctuary/Incursio's Meme Diffusion model will get the more realistic result while other Pony, Illustrious and NAI will remain anime styles

Recommended weight and settings:

  • 0.7 - 1.0 / 0.3 - 1.0 (v4)

  • Steps: 24 - 36

  • Sampler: Euler a

  • CFG Scale: 4

Version 4 Test:

Triggered Prompt: muses_in_dark

Extended Prompt:

  • dark theme, low light, realistic, inconsistent lighting,

  • realism, semi-realism (v3-v4 only)

Note: Be aware! Mixing too much LORAs may cause derailment on the main style of the model and LORA itself.

Recommended Settings for Advanced Usage:

To achieve the best quality and distinct artistic styles, I recommend the following configurations. These settings utilize "anti-burn" tools to allow for higher CFG scales without degrading the image.

I do not recommend using DPM++ samplers with Karras, as this combination often causes artifacts or distorted results.

1. ComfyUI Configuration

Prerequisite: Install the Skimmed_CFG node by Extraltodeus, This node prevents image "burn" at high CFG scales.

  • Choose one node: 'Skimmed CFG'; 'Skimmed CFG - replace'; 'Skimmed CFG - linear interpolation'; 'Skimmed CFG - linear interpolation dual scales'

  • Skimming Scale: 4/6

  • Main CFG Scale: 8/10/12

  • Steps: 24 - 36

  • Sampler: Euler ancestral

  • Schedule Type: Exponential, Normal, Align Your Steps.

2. A1111 / ForgeUI Configuration

Prerequisite: Use Dynamic Thresholding by mcmonkeyprojects. (Note: This is a built-in feature in ForgeUI, but must be installed as an extension in A1111.)

General Generation Settings:

  • Steps: 24 - 36

  • Sampler: Euler a

  • Schedule Type: Exponential/Polyexponential, Normal, Align Your Steps.

  • Main CFG Scale: 8/10/12

Dynamic Thresholding Settings:

  • Click on Enabled in Dynamic Thresholding's tab

  • Mimic Scale: 4/6

  • Threshold Percentile: 0.96 ~ 0.999 (never set it to 1)

  • Mimic Mode: Constant/Linear Down/Cosine Down/Power Down (your choice)

  • Mimic Scale Min: 1~3

  • CFG Mode: Constant/Linear Down/Cosine Down/Power Down (your choice)

  • CFG Scale Min: 1~4

  • Sched Val: 1

  • Everything else we can set either like this:

To further enhance image quality, consider using ADetailer and the Ultimate SD Upscale extension. Note that Ultimate SD Upscale is the only exception where DPM++ samplers are recommended.

If you love my works, please review them with images and consider tipping me some buzz. This would be my great motivation to release more Lora

modelVersions.name: KLSKX - Depth and Blurry
modelVersions.description:
Illustrious/WAI version. It is more like the artist style. Much more stable but less aesthetically pleasing and flexible than NoobAI-XL version.

Some information and tips from my experience.

  • Trained on the WAI-NSFW-illustrious-SDXL v8. But it seems to work fine on the v9 version as well.

  • Trained on artworks (edited in photoshop by me with some effects) of Kan Liu (666k).

  • The weight is around 0.7-0.8, but you can play with the values. Didn't experiment much yet.

  • Use a klskx tag.

  • Use ‘blurry background’, ‘depth of field’, ‘bokeh’ tags for blurred background.

  • Use tags ‘dynamic pose’, ‘dutch angle’ - for dynamics of the image.

  • Add ‘outdoors’ and ‘indoors’ tags depending on the scene. Optional.

  • Tags for lighting help aesthetics: 'backlighting', 'sidelighting', 'underlighting', 'sunrays', 'sunlight', 'dappled sunlight' etc.

  • Sometimes ‘hydrokinesis’ and ‘water’ appear. Just add them to the negative prompt. Or in the positive if you want to see it in the picture.

  • Artist tags seem to work pretty well and fit with this LoRA. Give it a try.

Still in the process of checking out this model

items.description:
Update Flux Version

The new version has been trained to work on Flux models. From my testing Flux is amazing with sentence like prompts, and turns booru prompts to anime pics that don't have a lot of details but this LoRA fixes that:

I tested it on SD Forge using the NF4 model and it work fine, you just need to change the Diffusion in Low Bits from Automatic to Automatic (fp16 LoRA) like this:

The rest of the LoRAs are designed to work with Pony Diffusion XL, or any other Pony model.

How to use

1- Manga Style (Blood Moon): Made from high quality monochrome images to give you a manga feel, oh and I called it blood moon because if you have something red in your prompt you might get a cool effect xD.

  • Trigger words: This LoRA is without Trigger Words, but having "monochrome, greyscale" in your prompt can greatly enhance the results.

  • Works on: 0.6-1 weights

2- Anime Illustrations Style: Made from very colorful and high quality data to improve your images and give them a badass feel.

  • Trigger words: MythAn1m3

  • Works on: 0.6-1 weights.

3- Portrait Style: This style is made to create high quality portraits of fantasy characters, and most of the training data is made with semi realistic art style.

  • Trigger words: MythP0rt

  • Works on: 0.6-1 weights.

4- Flux: This style is made to create high quality fantasy art, and it has training data similar to the Portrait Style

  • Trigger words: MythP0rt

  • Works on: 0.5-1.5 weights, feel free to experiment but I recommend you to put the weight at 1.

Other styles coming soon.

If you have any problem try copying generation data from my examples, or send me a DM

I can't wait to see what other people make with this :)

items.name: Semi (3 styles) | Semi in the Magic Cube | Illustrious
items.description:
This LoRA is a character LoRA of Semi from "Semi in the Magic Cube."

It has been trained on three styles: the default outfits from Season 1, the default outfits from Season 2, and Black Semi.

The recommended strength is 1, but if you want to dress the character in a different style and the existing trained outfits interfere, you can lower the strength to around 0.8–0.9 :)

The trigger words in bold below will generally help the character come out much better, but even if you don’t include the trigger words, the results are still fairly good.

Season 1 Semi

asemi, blue hair, braid, blue eyes, swept bangs, red hairornament, black hairband,

hanbok, white shirt, short sleeves, red skirt, white thighhighs, red gloves, fingerless gloves,

red footwear, heels, yellow toe cap,

Tip: If you use "hair ornament" together as "red hair ornament," the character’s hair will turn red, so it’s recommended to use "hairornament" as one word :)

Season 2 Semi

bsemi, blue hair, short hair, blue eyes, swept bangs,

white shirt, blue capelet, long sleeves, blue skirt,

white socks, black loafers,

(Optional : blue pointed shirt, white pointed skirt)

Black Semi

black jacket, leather, striped shirt, black shorts, white belt, see-through collarbone, fingerless gloves, black thighhighs, black boots,


P.S. When you enter "facial mark" in the prompt, the diamond mark from a playing card that appears on the face may sometimes show up reversed left to right. Please use inpainting!
